messages:
miriam: FYI - p95 for /v1/batch-infer spiked around 10:17 during the rollout. p50 looks fine, p99 barely moved. Anyone seen similar?

kai: saw it on my feed. p95 jumped ~100ms. I suspect a tiny cohort routing to a slower variant.

oscar: can you paste the console query so i can reproduce? There are a couple of percentiles paths that disagree if you mix realtime vs historical.

miriam: query i ran: `env:prod service:inference endpoint:/v1/batch-infer | percentile(latency_ms, 50,95,99) by endpoint, route` — dashboard shows the spike aligned with canary weight increase at 10:15.

telemetry-bot: Alert: p95(/v1/batch-infer) > 220ms at 2026-04-14T10:17:12Z — sample_count=380 (5m window).

lina: quick split by model_variant + route with counts helps. small noisy variant often moves combined p95 but not p99.

kai: ran it: main p95=115ms count=360, canary p95=420ms count=20, combined p95=140ms in exact query. realtime tile shows 240ms.

oscar: mismatch likely due to aggregator differences: realtime tiles use tdigest rollups, console exact queries use raw histograms when available. tdigest can overweight small high-latency groups depending on ingestion window.

miriam: so not a code bug — more an "explainability" issue. oncall sees realtime p95=240 and escalates, but exact view says combined ~140. confusing.

lina: we should add context to percentile tiles: show sample_count, aggregator_type (tdigest|exact), and a small "unstable" icon when sample_count < 50 or when variant fraction < 5%.

kai: also recommend adding a precomputed "cohort_influence" value in alerts: combined_p95 - p95_excluding_small_variants(threshold=5%). that would help triage.

oscar: agree. backend telemetry can compute influence cheaply if we store per-variant rollups during ingestion. we should add that to the alert attachment.

miriam: UX ask: in rollout UI show a tiny table: variant, p50/p95/p99, sample_count, fraction, CI. and default to hiding variants with fraction < 1% behind a "show small cohorts" toggle.

lina: for CI use simple percentile bootstrap or Wilson-based approximation depending on count; show numeric CI on hover. low-counts get a yellow badge: "low confidence".

kai: ops note: for quota fallback routes we want a "fallback_fraction" time series on the endpoint tile so we notice routing changes without ad-hoc queries.

oscar: telemetry action items: document tdigest vs exact differences in the README; add an internal API flag `histogram=raw` that returns bucketed counts so UIs can recompute consistent pcts.

miriam: action items: 1) Lina to mock the variant table + low-confidence badge in rollout UI (PR next week) 2) Oscar to add `histogram=raw` API and README note (telemetry) 3) Kai to add influence calculation & include it in alert payloads.

lina: i'll post mockups in #eng-platform later today.

oscar: i'll start the API patch and docs; will tag telemetry + eng-platform.

kai: i'll prototype influence in the alert generator and add a unit test showing how small cohorts change combined p95.

miriam: thanks team. if we can ship the UI quick wins (sample_count + aggregator label + low-confidence badge) that'll cut a lot of pager noise. :thumbsup:

telemetry-bot: Reminder: include aggregator_type and sample_count on percentile tiles and in alert attachments to prevent mistaken comparisons.
